Population increased in Warwick

The estimated population of Warwick in 2024 was 154,889 usual residents, a rise of 1.2% since 2023.

This meant that Warwick's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Warwick increased by 4.2%.

Over this slightly longer period, Warwick was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Warwick

The average (median) age stayed at 40.1 years between 2023 and 2024.

sections.content:
Warwick is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Warwick's population of 154,889 usual residents was made up of:

  • 27,152 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.5%)
  • 98,298 people aged 16 to 64 years, (63.5%)
  • 29,439 people aged 65 years and over, (19%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Warwick has a similar proportion of people in these age categories.

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Warwick, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Warwick
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Warwick, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 48 people (0%). In total, there were 1,348 births and 1,396 deaths in Warwick.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 917 (0.6%). There were 12,318 people entering the area and 11,401 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Warwick's population of 878 (0.6%) as a result of 2,196 people entering the area and 1,318 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Warwick was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Warwick in mid-2023 is 153,101.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 318 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 372 people.

In the 'other change' category (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners), we have revised the 2023 figure upwards by 2 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 52 people.
